cluster_takeaways: Partner sharing is now table stakes abroad: Natural Cycles Partner View (email invite, partner's own app + Apple Watch glance, she revokes) and Flo Partner (pairing code, partner pushes, min age 20 in Korea) both put the woman in control of what he sees - dulset must show its per-item control is finer than their fixed 3-category share.

In Korea, 페어오라 (Pairora) already combines IVF injection/med alarms with partner record sharing (free core in beta) - the closest local overlap with dulset's position; 퍼티바 adds 지원금-vs-spend cost tracking and exact-time injection push.

The wife's ovulation estimate may already exist on her wrist: Galaxy Watch5+/Galaxy Ring cycle tracking (Natural Cycles algorithm) is 식약처-approved in Korea since Feb 2023; Apple Watch gives only retrospective estimates. Reading it needs a native app (HealthKit / Health Connect have no web API), so a web-only prototype cannot import it.

Health Connect exposes Menstruation, Ovulation test (pos/neg), Cervical mucus, Sexual activity and Skin temperature records; HealthKit has equivalents - writing 'together days' and LH results there is the low-cost interop step once dulset goes native.

LH strip photo-reading (Premom) is the most copyable 'device' feature for software-only apps, but has no independent accuracy validation and reviews report variability by photo; hormone readers (Mira Ultra4 with 4 hormones, Inito) are moving to PdG/FSH confirmation that software cannot replicate.

Male-side devices (YO FDA, ExSeed CE with expert review, Korean 오뷰엠 from 2018) give the husband his own measurable task; no 식약처-approved phone sperm test was found, so dulset can at most guide him to a clinic 정액검사 and log the result.

AI chat has converged on 'grounded in your own log + strong disclaimer': Clue's chat refuses diagnosis/treatment, says user data never trains models, beta for paid US users only; Ask Flo is LLM-based; Korean 맘찌 AI charges US$4.99/mo with doctor mascots; 마미톡 and 베이비빌리 have no Q&A chatbot found.

Korean rules: 디지털의료제품법 in force 24 Jan 2026 created a voluntary 'digital medical/health-support device' registration (Samsung Health first, Jan 2026); 식약처 wellness criteria revised Feb 2026 keep anything aimed at diagnosis/treatment/prevention out of wellness; LLM medical-device guidance issued 2025 and June 2026 - consumer chatbots remain a grey zone, so dulset copy must avoid 진단/치료 wording.

Trust signals rivals lean on: FDA clearance (Natural Cycles x6, YO), CE (ExSeed), 식약처 approval (Samsung), and careful wording (Inito is only Class I registered yet resellers call it 'FDA-cleared'); a local-first app's best trust signal is the absence of servers plus explicit 'not diagnosis' copy.

KakaoTalk 알림톡 can reach users without channel friendship but only for template-reviewed informational messages, billed per message via official dealers (price not found); it suits clinic-day/injection reminders for a no-push web app but needs a server and phone number, breaking pure local-first.
